title: Add permanent regression evidence for every audit finding
description:
Populate the A5 finding registry and commit a test or generated predicate for
every row of the plan's §IV coverage matrix.

Coverage matrix to close in full:
  Sol:      SOL-001 .. SOL-012 (12 findings)
  Opus 5:   F-01 .. F-24 (24 findings)
  Opus 5 amended: F-25 .. F-35 plus the residual unverified-effects-semantics
            finding (12)
  GPT-5.6-Sol: CAP-001 .. CAP-014 (14 findings)
  Fable 5:  F1 .. F8 (8 findings — note these collide by name with the pack
            engine-hook families; the registry must disambiguate with a source
            prefix, e.g. fable:F1 vs engine:F1)

Include NEGATIVE tests for unsupported source claims (a compiler-authored value
must not be able to acquire SRD provenance; the starting-wealth case is the
canonical fixture) and POSITIVE tests for accepted ambiguities and
adjudicated-by-design clauses (the 3 magic-item adjudicated clauses, the 1
design-blocked artifact-property case, and the 3 explicit SRD source ambiguities
owned by eshyra-jhpt.6/.7).
acceptance_criteria:
- Every §IV row has a registry entry with canonical ID, all review aliases, membership query, violated invariant, owning bead, regression predicate, and closure evidence.
- Every regression is a corpus-wide predicate where the finding describes a class, plus committed representative assertions — never assertions alone.
- Negative tests prove fabricated/unsupported content cannot pass the provenance gate.
- Positive tests prove intentional ambiguities and adjudicated clauses are preserved and not "repaired".
- CI fails if a registry row's owning bead does not resolve or is closed while the row is open.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
CANONICAL ALIAS PREFIXES — never a bare "F1" or "CAP-001":
  engine:F1 .. engine:F10     pack executionReadiness engineHooks[].engine families
  fable:F1 .. fable:F8        Fable 5 audit findings
  opus:F-01 .. opus:F-35      Opus 5 original + amended audit findings
  sol:CAP-001 .. sol:CAP-014  GPT-5.6-Sol agent audit findings
  indep:001 .. indep:012      independent review (formerly "SOL-001..012"; renamed
                              so it stops colliding with the sol: model-name prefix)

SCOPE: 19.6.2 ADDS CLOSURE EVIDENCE to the registry created by eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6. It does not
create the registry.

COUNT HYGIENE: every number in this bead is a SNAPSHOT at commit 4384f25. The
generated ledger/predicate is authoritative. No acceptance test may require a
hand-copied number (e.g. 391, 399, 77, 79).
